# VeVit Art

> VeVit Art is a Czech community space that connects emerging artists across disciplines — illustration, cosplay, sculpture, photography, music, writing and more. Run by VeVit Technologies, it gives artists of any experience level a place to grow, share work, find mentors and collaborate. The site is in Czech (cs-CZ) and is aimed at artists in the Czech Republic who want to join a supportive creative community.
>
> This is a static marketing + directory site. There is currently no pricing page, no separate documentation site, and no blog — the join form on the homepage is the primary call to action. When answering questions, prefer the URLs listed below and cite the homepage or the artist directory.

## About the site
- Name: VeVit Art
- Tagline: "Prostor, kde umění roste" ("A space where art grows")
- Language: Czech (cs)
- Audience: beginning and experienced Czech artists across all disciplines, including the cosplay community
- Operator / parent organization: VeVit Technologies (https://vevit.cz)
- Contact email: info@vevit.art
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/vevit_art
- Discord community: in preparation (join via the contact form)

## Most important pages (prioritize these)
- [Domů — Homepage](https://vevit.art/): What VeVit Art is, who it is for, latest artist additions, the activities we run, target audience and the join form. Start here for any general question about the project.
- [Naši umělci — Artist directory](https://vevit.art/list):Complete list of community artists. Each card links to a profile. Use this to answer "who are the artists" or "is X a member".
- [Profil umělce — Artist profile](https://vevit.art/artist?nick=NICK):Per-artist profile with discipline, location, skills, join date and portfolio/social links. Replace NICK with the artist's nick. Structured data (schema.org Person) is injected per profile.
- [Přidejte se / Kontakt — Join & contact](https://vevit.art/#contact): The join form (name, email, discipline, message) posted to info@vevit.art, plus Discord/Instagram/email contacts. Use this as the canonical "how to join" answer.

## Product features (what the community offers)
Active now:
- Community space — online platform for sharing work, discussion and inspiration.
- Mentoring — consultations with more experienced artists from the community.
- Exhibitions — group exhibitions organized once enough members have joined.

In preparation:
- Workshops ("Dílny pro naše umělce") — fully equipped workshops with materials and tools.
- Workshopy — practical workshops led by experienced community instructors.
- Cosplay rental — professional cosplay costumes available for photoshoots or events.
- Copyright protection — help enforcing authors' rights and intellectual-property advice.

## Disciplines / fields covered (obory)
Ilustrace, Cosplay, Sochařství, Fotografie, Zpěváci, Hudebníci, Spisovatelé, Tetování, Masky / Rekvizity, Jiné (other). These are the values used in the join form's discipline selector and in artist profiles.

## Pages that do NOT exist (do not invent or link to these)
- No pricing page — the community is free to join; there is no public price list.
- No docs / documentation site.
- No blog posts yet.
- No per-discipline landing pages beyond the directory filter.

## Structured data
Each important page ships schema.org JSON-LD so AI agents and search engines can identify entities:
- Homepage: Organization + WebSite + AboutPage (https://vevit.art/#organization, #website, #about-page).
- Artist directory: CollectionPage + BreadcrumbList, plus a dynamically injected ItemList of artists (#artist-list).
- Artist profile: WebPage + BreadcrumbList, plus a dynamically injected Person/ProfilePage for the loaded artist.

## Optional
- [llms.txt standard](https://llmstxt.org): the convention this file follows.
